title: Billing Plans and Service Fees on the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy
content:
Billing plans each CondoGuard tier allows, and the fee amounts the billing office charges by tier. A fee whose tier amount is 0.00 is not charged on that tier.

## Billing plans allowed

| Tier | Annual | Two-pay | Quarterly | Monthly EFT | Mortgagee escrow |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential | yes | yes | no | yes | yes |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Enhanced | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Essential | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature | yes | yes | yes | no | yes |

## Fees and billing figures

| Tier | Service charge per two-pay or quarterly installment after the first (USD) | Service charge per monthly EFT installment after the first (USD) | Late fee per late installment (USD) | Days past due before a late fee (calendar days) | Fee per returned payment (USD) | Smallest credit balance refunded (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential | 5.00 | 2.00 | 10.00 | 10 | 25.00 | 5.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Enhanced | 5.00 | 2.00 | 10.00 | 10 | 25.00 | 5.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Essential | 5.00 | 2.00 | 10.00 | 10 | 25.00 | 5.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced | 4.00 | 1.00 | 10.00 | 10 | 25.00 | 5.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier | 3.00 | 0.00 | 5.00 | 10 | 20.00 | 5.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 10 | 0.00 | 5.00 |

## Reading the fee table (hypothetical cases)

- CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature shows 0.00 for both service charges, the late fee and the returned-payment fee, so none of those fees is charged on that tier.
- On CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier the monthly EFT service charge is 0.00 and is not charged, while each two-pay or quarterly installment after the first carries 3.00 USD.
- Quarterly billing is not offered on CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential, and monthly EFT is not offered on CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature.
